Validate NPX data structure

Source: R/utils.R
validate_npx.Rd

Checks that a data frame has the minimum required columns for long-format NPX data. Warnings are issued for common issues; errors for missing columns.

Usage

validate_npx(
  data,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  sample_col = NULL,
  fail_on_missing = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame or data.table.

assay_col

Name of the assay/protein column. If NULL, auto-detected from common names such as `Assay`, `Protein`, or `feature_name`.

value_col

Name of the NPX value column. If NULL, auto-detected from common names such as `NPX` or `Value`.

sample_col

Name of the sample identifier column. If NULL, auto-detected from common names such as `SampleID` or `SubjectID`.

fail_on_missing

If TRUE, stops on missing columns; otherwise warns.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE if all checks pass.
